name: Harness²
description: Optimizes an agent's harness (prompts, tools, memory, skills, subagents) on unseen tasks through recursive Propose–Probe–Compose refinement, for researchers benchmarking agents.

skills.name: Task-Level Recursion
skills.description: Proposes harness edits, probes their effects on the same task, and composes a refined harness without ground-truth feedback.

skills.name: Harnessing-Level Recursion
skills.description: Updates a persistent improvement harness with adopted harnesses and lessons from each task to guide later refinement.

skills.name: Parallel and Sequential Recursion
skills.description: Explores K candidate harnesses in parallel or refines one harness through K successive steps.

skills.name: Benchmark Runs
skills.description: Sets up, runs, judges, and reports JobBench, LAB, and WorkBuddy-Bench tasks with OpenCode or Codex executors.
